title: DescribeValueTypeResult - Metadata API
description: Contains information about a value type that’s useful for developers working with declarative metadata.

fields.description: The ValueTypeField object for the next field, if any.

foreignKeyDomain.description: If isForeignKey is True, foreignKeyDomain is the type of object, such as Account or Opportunity.

isForeignKey.description: True if the field is a foreign key. That means this field is the primary key in a different database table.

isNameField.description: True if this value type field is a fullName field; otherwise False.

minOccurs.description: 1 if this field is required, 0 otherwise.

name.description: The name of this value type field. The name is null for parent fields.

picklistValues.description: The individual picklist values if the field is a picklist.

soapType.description: The data type of the field, such as boolean or double.

valueRequired.description: Indicates whether this value type field must have a value (true) or can be null (false).

active.description: True if the picklist value is active and displayed in the drop-down list for the picklist field in the user interface. False if the picklist value is inactive.

defaultValue.description: True if the picklist value is a default value, otherwise, False.

label.description: Display name of this item in the picklist.

value.description: Value of this item in the picklist.
